newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P puts Yasuda Trust debt ratings on CreditWatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Yasuda Trust debt ratings on CreditWatch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Friday it had placed Yasuda Trust & Banking Co Ltd's short- and long-term debt ratings, it counterparty rating and related entities on CreditWatch with negative implications.

The credit rating firm said the CreditWatch action reflects its concerns about Yasuda's future operating performance in light of the increasingly competitive business environment and the bank's lingering asset-quality problems.
Yasuda Trust's long-term counterparty credit is currently rated BBB-. Its certificates of deposit are rated BBB-/A-3.
Yasuda Trust Australia Ltd's senior unsecured debt, which is guaranteed by Yasuda Trust, is rated BBB-.
